basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 29-year-old freelance graphic designer based in Seattle, Washington. I have a strong passion for space exploration games and love diving deep into virtual worlds. When I'm not gaming, you can find me sketching sci-fi landscapes or watching documentaries about the cosmos. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after 7 PM PST. I love engaging with communities that share my interests in gaming and science fiction.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital art and design, which I studied in college. My expertise in space exploration games comes from years of playing and discussing them. I often read forums and watch YouTube reviews to stay updated. Moreover, I contribute to discussions by sharing my insights on game mechanics and visual aesthetics.
